objective: Bring the Divino-matic Rod to Chief Engineer Bilgewhizzle in Gadgetzan.

description: Sergeant Bly stole from me!  He said he'd only borrow it, but he stole my cherished divino-matic rod!!  Without that rod how will I know where to dig new water holes??
Find Bly and bring me my rod!  I heard he led his band of ill-reputed adventurers to go treasure hunting in Zul'Farrak to the west.  I bet you'll find him there.
Let's hope the trolls took care of him, because if you have to fight him for the rod then you're in for a serious fight.
progress: Did you find Sergeant Bly?  Did you get my divino-matic rod?
completion: You found it! Well done, <name>! Did you have to fight Bly for it? I hope you knocked him and his band down good and hard!

note: The rod drops from Sergeant Bly after the pyramid event.
